name: @lit-core/elem-proxy
description: General-purpose AOT compiler transform replacing eager Custom Element registrations with lightweight proxy stubs

scripts.build: cargo build --release && cp target/release/libelem_proxy.dylib elem-proxy.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null && (codesign -s - -f elem-proxy.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true) || true
scripts.build:debug: cargo build && cp target/debug/libelem_proxy.dylib elem-proxy.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null && (codesign -s - -f elem-proxy.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true) || true
